thread:
neil: deploy-bot is recommending a partial rollback for ml-inference after we promoted v6.0.0. Hosted looks noisy in canary but EU Dedicated lanes must stay pinned for migration. Need decision: partial rollback (hosted only) or full rollback?
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary ml-inference p95=890ms (baseline 320ms), errors 1.9% -> 5.2%. suggested revert: v5.9.6. evidence: https://telemetry.redwood/canary/4298
anya: quick context: v6.0.0 included new compilation kernel + quantization toggle. Dedicated EU pools were pinned to v6.0.0 intentionally for compatibility tests.
ash: if we full rollback we might break the in-progress EU migration tests. partial rollback (hosted) seems safest. can we route hosted canary back to v5.9.6 and keep dedicated pinned?
ash: also need manual approval since deploy-bot would otherwise autorevert everything.
oncall-ops: change window 05:00-07:00 UTC. canary slice is 12% hosted, dedicated slice 8%. autorevert would hit both unless suppressed. recommend suppress autorevert and run targeted rollback for hosted pool.
product-ops: CS wants a short blurb either way. if we do partial rollback, we should mention dedicated lanes unaffected. drafting now.
legal: cc. flag if any customer pinned to hosted v6.0.0. otherwise ok.
neil: suppressing deploy-bot autorevert for 10m: `deployctl suppress-autorevert --svc ml-inference --for 10m`
anya: checking pins: eu-dedicated group pinned to v6.0.0, org-wide hosted default is v6.0.0. we can limit revert to "hosted" by specifying lane param.
neil: proposed command: ```release rollback --svc ml-inference --to v5.9.6 --lane hosted --strategy rolling --slice 12 --reason "canary regression; preserve dedicated pin"```
ash: assign @ash to execute hosted rollback; @anya monitor dedicated lanes. ash can you run in 2m?
ash: also add note to release board to pin dedicated to v6.0.0 for the migration window.
ash: ops checklist: pause autoscale on hosted canary, revert, smoke, re-enable autoscale.
ash: disable autoscale: `infractl autoscale set ml-hosted-canary --min 0 --max 0`
ash: revert started. deploy-bot: ACTION: hosted rollback initiated by ash. progress: 15% -> 45% -> 80% -> 100%.
ash: hosted telemetry after rollback p95=340ms errors 0.7%. dedicated lane still at v6.0.0 with higher p95 but isolated.
product-ops: blurb: "We detected a performance regression in a hosted canary for ml-inference and rolled back hosted to v5.9.6. Dedicated customer lanes remain on v6.0.0 to preserve migration testing. No customer data impacted. Engineering is investigating." sending to CSMs.
cs-lead: thanks, I'll notify affected customers. note about dedicated pin included.
legal: please record: partial rollback executed to avoid disrupting EU migration. no SLA breach expected.
anya: capturing traces from dedicated pool for RCA. will compare kernel selector behavior between lanes.
oncall-ops: monitoring both hosted and dedicated for 3h with tightened p95 alerts for hosted. temporary alert rule added: hosted canary p95 threshold 380ms.
neil: publish release note snippet and mark dedicated pinned in release board.
ash: who owns RCA? anya + infra-team?
anya: I'll lead RCA, infra-team supporting. will post preliminary findings in 6h.
ash: final: partial rollback complete, dedicated lanes pinned, customers notified, RCA assigned. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
